starnames.cn.name: Chinese star names
starnames.cn.description: A CSV table of Chinese star names from d3-celestial, with source identifiers, designations, English translations and pinyin. It contains no geometry and complements the star position catalogs; identifiers should be matched using the source catalog conventions.
starnames.cn.citeAs: Part of Celestial Data (1.0.1), collection DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7561601. The DOI identifies the archived collection, not a separate DOI for this dataset.

recordSet.name: records
recordSet.description: One record per source feature or CSV row in its original order. No values are imputed. Publication dates describe the collection release, not observations; J2000 is a celestial reference epoch, not a file date. The row-position key is local to this snapshot.

field.name: record_index
